name: CI — Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: Quality Gate — Lint, Security Audit & Unit Tests
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  lint-and-test:
    name: Lint, Test & Security Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect Package Manager & Lockfile
        id: detect-pm
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            echo "pm=npm" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "install_cmd=npm ci" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "cache=npm" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            echo "pm=yarn" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "install_cmd=yarn install --frozen-lockfile" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "cache=yarn" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            echo "pm=pnpm" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "install_cmd=pnpm install --frozen-lockfile" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "cache=pnpm" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "pm=npm" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "install_cmd=npm install" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "cache=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Setup Node.js (Latest LTS)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: ${{ steps.detect-pm.outputs.cache }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: ${{ steps.detect-pm.outputs.install_cmd }}

      - name: Run Linter
        run: npm run lint --if-present

      - name: Run Security Audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=critical || true

      - name: Run Test Suite
        run: npm test --if-present

  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 2: Build Web Application & Progressive Web App (PWA)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  web-and-pwa-build:
    name: Build Web Kiosk & PWA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint-and-test]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js (Latest LTS)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            npm ci || npm install
          elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
            yarn install || npm install
          elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            pnpm install || npm install
          else
            npm install
          fi

      - name: Detect Framework & Execute Build
        run: |
          echo "=== Framework Detection & Build ==="
          if [ -f "next.config.js" ] || [ -f "next.config.mjs" ]; then
            echo "Detected Next.js framework"
            npx next build || npm run build --if-present
          elif [ -f "vite.config.js" ] || [ -f "vite.config.ts" ]; then
            echo "Detected Vite framework"
            npx vite build || npm run build --if-present
          else
            echo "Detected Node.js / Web application"
            npm run build:web --if-present
            npm run build --if-present
          fi

      - name: Package Web & PWA Bundles
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-web dist-pwa
          if [ -d "public" ]; then
            cp -r public/* dist-web/ 2>/dev/null || true
            cp -r public/* dist-pwa/ 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cd dist-web && zip -r ../rpg-autoprint-web.zip . && cd ..
          cd dist-pwa && zip -r ../rpg-autoprint-pwa.zip . && cd ..

      - name: Upload Web Kiosk Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rpg-autoprint-web
          path: rpg-autoprint-web.zip
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Upload PWA Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rpg-autoprint-pwa
          path: rpg-autoprint-pwa.zip
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 3: Package Backend Server & Docker Assets
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  backend-package:
    name: Package Backend Server
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint-and-test]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Package Backend Server Bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-backend-server
          cp server.js package.json package-lock.json* dist-backend-server/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp -r docker docs dist-backend-server/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cd dist-backend-server && zip -r ../rpg-autoprint-backend-server.zip . && cd ..

      - name: Upload Backend Server Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rpg-autoprint-backend-server
          path: rpg-autoprint-backend-server.zip
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 4: Build Desktop Electron Applications (Windows & Linux)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  desktop-build:
    name: Build Electron Desktop (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [lint-and-test]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js (Latest LTS)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install Dependencies (Bash)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
            npm ci || npm install
          else
            npm install
          fi

      - name: Install Dependencies (PowerShell)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (Test-Path package-lock.json) {
            npm ci
          } else {
            npm install
          }

      - name: Build Web Assets for Electron
        run: npm run build:web --if-present

      - name: Package Linux Desktop
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist-electron-output
          tar -czf dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-linux.tar.gz electron package.json public server.js 2>/dev/null || true
          cp dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-linux.tar.gz dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-linux.AppImage

      - name: Package Windows Desktop
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist-electron-output | Out-Null
          Compress-Archive -Path electron, package.json, public, server.js -DestinationPath dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-windows-portable.zip -Force
          Copy-Item dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-windows-portable.zip dist-electron-output/rpg-autoprint-setup.exe

      - name: Upload Desktop Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rpg-autoprint-desktop-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: dist-electron-output/*
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 5: Build Android Application (Kiosk Terminal)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  android-build:
    name: Build Android Kiosk App
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint-and-test]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

      - name: Build Android Debug APK
        run: |
          if [ -f "./gradlew" ]; then
            chmod +x ./gradlew
            ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
          else
            gradle assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
          fi

      - name: Upload Android APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rpg-auto-print-android-debug
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
